name: wait-review
description: Turns the wait while Claude works into incremental review of the diff it already wrote.

settleTurns.description: Turns a file must go untouched before its hunks are offered for review. 0 offers them at the end of the turn that wrote them.
settleTurns.title: Settle turns

contextLines.description: Lines of context around each hunk (git --unified).
contextLines.title: Context lines

autoOpen.description: Open the review pane when the session starts.
autoOpen.title: Open pane at session start

attachFlags.description: Attach flagged hunks to your next message as review notes for Claude.
attachFlags.title: Send flagged hunks to Claude

ignore.title: Files to leave out
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs whose hunks are never queued. Empty uses the built-in list of lockfiles, build output and snapshots.
